He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech Red Raiders]]. ==High school career== As a freshman and sophomore, Ramsey played basketball for [[Mansfield Summit High School]] in his hometown of [[Arlington, Texas]].{{cite web|first=Callie|last=Caplan|title=2019 SportsDayHS boys basketball Player of the Year: Duncanville guard Jahmius Ramsey|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/2019/03/21/2019-sportsdayhs-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year-duncanville-guard-jahmius-ramsey/|work=[[The Dallas Morning News]]|date=March 21, 2019|access-date=October 9, 2019}} Entering his junior season, he transferred to [[IMG Academy]], a prominent [[College-preparatory school|prep school]] in [[Bradenton, Florida]], where he played a national schedule and started drawing more college interest.{{cite web|first=Evan|last=Daniels|title=Jahmius Ramsey shows versatility as interest rises|url=https://247sports.com/Article/Jahmius-Ramsey-shows-versatility-as-interest-rises-112417405/|website=247Sports.com|date=December 18, 2017|access-date=October 9, 2019}} For his senior year, Ramsey moved to [[Duncanville High School]] in [[Duncanville, Texas]], after initially intending to join national powerhouse [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]].{{cite web|first=Cam|last=Smith|title=After transferring from IMG to Oak Hill, four-star Jahmius Ramsey transfers (again) to Duncanville (Texas)|url=https://usatodayhss.com/2018/after-transferring-from-img-to-oak-hill-four-star-jahmius-ramsey-transfers-again-to-duncanville-texas|work=USA Today High School Sports|date=September 24, 2018|access-date=September 29, 2019}} He averaged 21 points and six rebounds per game, leading his team to a Class 6A state championship. On April 20, 2019, Ramsey posted 15 points, six rebounds, and two steals at the [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite web|title=Apr 20, 2019 - Away 132 at Home 125|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/highschool/jordan_classic/Boxscore/2019|website=RealGM.com|date=April 20, 2019|access-date=October 9, 2019}} On May 4, he shared [[most valuable player]] (MVP) honors with [[Isaiah Mobley]] at the [[Ballislife All-American Game]].{{cite web|first=Adam|last=Wells|title=Team Elite Wins BallisLife All-American Game; Isaiah Mobley, Jahmius Ramsey MVPs|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2834696-team-elite-wins-ballislife-all-american-game-isaiah-mobley-jahmius-ramsey-mvps|work=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=May 4, 2019|access-date=September 29, 2019}} ===Recruiting=== Ramsey was considered a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[Rivals.com|Rivals]] and a four-star recruit by [[ESPN]] and [[247Sports.com|247Sports]]. On November 28, 2018, he committed to play college basketball for [[Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball|Texas Tech]] over [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] and many other [[NCAA Division I]] programs. Ramsey became the highest-ranked recruit in school history and its first five-star recruit.{{cite web|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|title=Jahmius Ramsey, No. 28 in ESPN 100, commits to Texas Tech|url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/25215913/texas-tech-red-raiders-get-commitment-jahmius-ramsey|work=[[ESPN]]|date=November 8, 2018|access-date=October 12 rebounds for Texas Tech in a 94–92 preseason win over Serbian professional team [[KK Mega Basket|Mega Bemax]] on the Red Raiders International Tour in [[The Bahamas]].{{cite web|first=Pete|last=Christy|title=Ramsey scores 44 to help Texas Tech win in the Bahamas|url=https://www.kcbd.com/2019/08/16/ramsey-scores-help-texas-tech-win-bahamas/|publisher=[[KCBD]]|date=August 15, 2019|access-date=October 9, 2019}} He scored 19 points in his regular-season debut, an 85–60 win over [[Eastern Illinois Panthers men's basketball|Eastern Illinois]].{{cite news|title=National runner-up Texas Tech opens with 85–60 victory|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401169597|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=November 5, 2019|access-date=November 5, 2019}} After scoring 27 points with five 3-pointers and six rebounds versus [[LIU Blackbirds men's basketball|LIU]], Ramsey was named [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] newcomer of the week on November 25, 2019.{{cite web|title=Butler and Ramsey Receive Men's Basketball Weekly Honors|url=https://big12sports.com/news/2019/11/25/butler-and-ramsey-receive-mens-basketball-weekly-honors.aspx|website=Big12.com|publisher=Big 12 Conference|date=November 25, 2019|access-date=December 2, 2019}} Ramsey injured his hamstring in a loss to [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] on November 28 and missed several games.{{cite news|title=Report: Jahmi'us Ramsey to miss Texas Tech's game vs. No. 1 Louisville|url=https://www.everythinglubbock.com/sports/red-raider-nation/report-jahmius-ramsey-to-miss-texas-techs-game-vs-no-1-louisville/|work=KLBK|date=December 10, 2019|access-date=December 11, 2019}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Ramsey was named [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] Freshman of the Year and Second Team All-Conference.{{cite press release|title=Men's Basketball All-Big 12 Awards Announced|url=https://big12sports.com/news/2020/3/7/mens-basketball-all-big-12-awards-announced.aspx|work=[[Big 12 Conference]]|date=March 8, 2020|access-date=March 8, 2020}}{{cite web|title=Men's Basketball All-Big 12 Awards Announced|url=https://big12sports.com/documents/2020/3/8//All_Big_12_Release_19_20_.pdf|work=[[Big 12 Conference]]|date=March 8, 2020|access-date=March 8, 2020}} Ramsey averaged 15 points, 4 rebounds, 2.2 assists and 1.3 steals per game.{{cite news|first=Scott|last=Chasen|title=AP awards roundup: Udoka Azubuike wins Big 12 player of the year|url=https://247sports.com/college/kansas/Article/AP-awards-roundup-Udoka-Azubuike-wins-Big-12-player-of-the-year-144855766/|work=247 Sports|date=March 10, 2020|access-date=March 24, 2020}} On April 25, 2020, Ramsey declared he would be entering the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite tweet|first=Ramsey|last=Jahmi'us|title=❤️🖤!! #ThankyouGOD|number=1254157496844980224|user=newanimprovedjr|date=April 25, 2020|access-date=November 6, 2020}} ==Professional career== ===Sacramento Kings (2020–2022)=== On November 18, 2020, Ramsey was selected with the 43rd pick in the [[2020 NBA draft]] by the [[Sacramento Kings]].{{cite web|title=Kings Select Jahmi'us Ramsey in the Second Round of the 2020 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-select-jahmius-ramsey-second-round-2020-nba-draft|website=NBA.com|date=November 18, 2020|access-date=November 22, 2020}} On December 4, he signed a multi-year contract with the Kings.{{cite web|title=Kings Sign Jahmi'us Ramsey|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-sign-jahmius-ramsey|website=NBA.com|date=December 4, 2020|access-date=December 5, 2020}} Ramsey made 13 appearances for Sacramento during his rookie campaign, averaging 3.1 points, 0.8 rebounds, and 0.5 assists.{{Cite web|title=Jahmi'us Ramsey 2020-21 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4431688/type/nba/year/2021|access-date=June 29, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} Ramsey played in 19 contests for the Kings during the [[2021–22 NBA season]], recording averages of 3.2 points, 0.7 rebounds, and 0.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Jahmi'us Ramsey 2021-22 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4431688/type/nba/year/2022|access-date=June 29, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On February 11, 2022, Ramsey was waived by the Kings.{{cite web|title=Kings Acquire Donte DiVincenzo, Josh Jackson and Trey Lyles in Three-Team Trade|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-acquire-donte-divincenzo-josh-jackson-and-trey-lyles-four-team-deal|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 10, 2022}} ===Oklahoma City Blue / Toronto Raptors / Raptors 905 (2022–2024)=== Following his release, Ramsey signed an [[NBA G League]] entry contract, and was picked up by the [[Birmingham Squadron]] off of waivers. He was traded to the [[Oklahoma City Blue]] the following day in exchange for [[Chasson Randle]].{{cite web|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 23, 2022}} On October 20, 2023, Ramsey signed with the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]], but was waived the same day{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Thunder Sign, Waive Jahmi'us Ramsey, Jaden Shackelford|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/10/thunder-sign-jahmius-ramsey-jaden-shackelford.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 20, 2023|access-date=October 22, 2023}} and on October 31, he re-joined the [[Oklahoma City Blue]].{{cite tweet|author=OKC BLUE|title=Let's work 🫡 2023-24 #OKCBlue Training Camp Roster🔵|number=1719380343176716560|user=okcblue|date=October 31, 2023|access-date=November 21, 2023}} On March 5, 2024, Ramsey signed a 10-day contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{cite web|title=RAPTORS SIGN RAMSEY TO 10-DAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-ramsey-to-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 5, 2024|access-date=March 5, 2024}} On March 14, he signed a second 10-day contract with the team.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Raptors Sign Jahmi'us Ramsey To Second 10-Day Deal|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/03/raptors-sign-jahmius-ramsey-to-second-10-day-deal.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=March 14, 2024|access-date=March 15, 2024}} Ramsey made seven total appearances (including one start) for Toronto, averaging 6.7 points, 3.1 rebounds, and 1.1 assists.{{Cite web|title=Jahmi'us Ramsey 2023-24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4431688/type/nba/year/2024|access-date=June 29, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On March 25, he returned to the Blue.{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Oklahoma City Blue Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Oklahoma-City-Blue/38/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=March 26, 2024}} On September 26, 2024, Ramsey re-signed with Toronto,{{cite web|title=RAPTORS SIGN RAMSEY|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-ramsey|website=NBA.com|date=September 26, 2024|access-date=September 26, 2024}} but was waived on October 19.{{cite web|title=RAPTORS WAIVE THREE, CONVERT BATTLE TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-waive-three-convert-battle-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 19, 2024}} ===Return to Oklahoma City Blue (2024–2025)=== On October 25, 2024, Ramsey rejoined the [[Oklahoma City Blue]].{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Oklahoma City Blue Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Oklahoma-City-Blue/38/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=November 11, 2024}} ===Pallacanestro Trieste (2025–present)=== On July 25, 2025, Ramsey signed with [[Pallacanestro Trieste]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]].{{Cite web|title=Jahmi’us Ramsey reunites with Texas Tech teammate Davide Moretti at Trieste|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1851320/jahmius-ramsey-signs-with-trieste-basketball-champions-league/|access-date=July 30, 2025|website=eurohoops.net|language=es}}
